docs.purpose: Lets an admin browse the raw data rows a single pipeline step actually produced — for example what a parcel-linking run wrote — with optional filtering, so they can inspect and troubleshoot pipeline output directly in the admin UI.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `information_schema.columns` and `pg_class` and writes nothing. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 5 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `src/features/admin-flight-center/api/useStepOutput.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: The browsed table is NOT fixed — it is resolved per request from manifest.json's telemetry_tables, allow-listed against a PII-exclusion set in src/lib/admin/manifest-utils.ts, so the actual data table read varies by slug; information_schema.columns and pg_class are the only statically named relations (both Postgres catalogs). The file's own SPEC LINK cites a docs/specs/01-pipeline/26_*.md path that does not exist; the real spec at that number is the one recorded here. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: Census listed information_schema.columns + pg_class only. CONFIRMED both, plus TWO tables the census MISSED: pg_namespace (joined at src/lib/admin/step-output-query.ts:56) and `profiles` (via verifyAdminAuth). The route's real data read is a DYNAMIC table — 55 manifest slugs resolving to 28 distinct tables (computed from scripts/manifest.json telemetry_tables[0] minus the PII exclusion set at src/lib/admin/manifest-utils.ts:16-22): address_points, building_footprints, coa_applications, cost_estimates, data_quality_snapshots, engine_health_snapshots, entities, heritage_properties, lead_parcels, lead_trades, neighbourhood_build_norms, neighbourhood_storey_norms, neighbourhoods, parcel_address_points, parcel_buildings, parcels, permit_inspections, permit_parcels, permit_trades, permits, phase_calibration, phase_stay_calibration, pipeline_runs, ravines, toronto_centreline, trade_forecasts, wsib_registry, zoning_bylaw_areas. The projection is effectively SELECT-all-columns: every information_schema column of the target table is projected (src/lib/admin/step-output-query.ts:38-39,80) — not a literal `SELECT *`, but the same disclosure surface, and `rows` is an unfiltered row spread. Table/column identifiers are interpolated into the SQL text (src/lib/admin/step-output-query.ts:66,71,80) — fenced by the manifest allow-list plus quoteIdent's [A-Za-z0-9_] regex (src/lib/admin/manifest-utils.ts:50-53); the filter VALUE is bound. The `spec_link_header` names `26_*.md` with a literal glob, not a resolvable path. | Caching: none observed — no dynamic/revalidate/Cache-Control under src/app/api/admin/pipeline/ (grep returned nothing); STEP_TELEMETRY_TABLES is computed once at module load from the bundled manifest (src/lib/admin/manifest-utils.ts:32), which is build-time state, not a request cache | Pagination: limit 1..100 default 50 and offset >=0 default 0, clamped by Zod at src/lib/admin/types.ts:9-10 and bound as $n params at src/lib/admin/step-output-query.ts:77-81 | Other guards / classification: MFA/aal2 gate at src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:143-173 (inert unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED); CSRF Origin check does not apply (GET, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:45,70). Injection fences: manifest allow-list at src/lib/admin/manifest-utils.ts:32-41, PII table exclusion at :16-22, quoteIdent at :50-53, SET LOCAL statement_timeout 15000ms at src/lib/admin/step-output-query.ts:48. | Locking tests: src/tests/step-output-query.infra.test.ts.
